ALSA: hda/realtek: Add special fixup for Lenovo 14IRP8

Lenovo Slim/Yoga Pro 9 14IRP8 requires a special fixup because there is
a collision of its PCI SSID (17aa:3802) with Lenovo Yoga DuetITL 2021
codec SSID.
